whenToUse: Thin rules between a heading and its body, or between the stacked rows of a list or a summary
Vertical rules between inline labels or side by side menu entries along one row
Labeled breaks with a short caption centered on the rule, like an or continue with line

whenNotToUse.when: A trail of links from the current page back up to its parent pages
Step lines and named phase breaks in an agent run log or transcript
A list of rows each led by an avatar or icon, with text and an action

agentNotes: The base `Separator` renders role separator, while the radix twin defaults `decorative` to true and renders role none, hidden from screen readers
A vertical `Separator` takes its height from `self-stretch`, so it shows only in a flex row or grid unless given a height such as `h-8`
